subject: NaN for infit statistics with missing values

messages.author: e5ff62f07434a294
messages.subject: NaN for infit statistics with missing values
parts:
I'm using mirt version 1.41 and when I try to calculate 'infit' statistics with
itemfit(x, fit_stats = 'infit')
I get all NaNs for any item that has even a single NaN. Does anyone else have this issue and can offer a solution?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: NaN for infit statistics with missing values
parts:
Indeed, infit/outfit should have worked with missing data, however there were a few areas in the code that needed na.rm=TRUE flags to make this work correctly. The dev now works more naturally with missing data (see example below)

devtools::install_github('philchalmers/mirt')
library(mirt)
P <- function(Theta){exp(Theta^2 * 1.2 - 1) / (1 + exp(Theta^2 * 1.2 - 1))}

set.seed(1234)
a <- matrix(rlnorm(20, meanlog=0, sdlog = .1),ncol=1)
d <- matrix(rnorm(20),ncol=1)
Theta <- matrix(rnorm(2000))
items <- rep('2PL', 20)
ps <- P(Theta)
baditem <- numeric(2000)
for(i in 1:2000)
    baditem[i] <- sample(c(0,1), 1, prob = c(1-ps[i], ps[i]))
data <- cbind(simdata(a,d, 2000, items, Theta=Theta), baditem=baditem)

datmiss <- data
datmiss[sample(1:length(data), 50)] <- NA

raschfit <- mirt(data, 1, itemtype='Rasch')
raschfit_miss <- mirt(datmiss, 1, itemtype='Rasch')

itemfit(raschfit)
itemfit(raschfit, fit_stats = 'infit', method='ML')

itemfit(raschfit_miss)   # fails
itemfit(raschfit_miss, na.rm = TRUE)  # missing removed
itemfit(raschfit_miss, fit_stats = 'infit', method='ML')  # missing left but infit/outfit still computed
